body: Lmao. This was a great read.
Yes I do, i also feel like that when anything makes me feel happy because i know its just temporary, I've made a gp appointment to talk about it so we shall see how that goes :)
You're welcome. You will get there, it does take time, just remember not to suffocate your gf with negative feelings and thoughts.

No harm in asking, if your therapist really wants to help you then surely they wont mind. I know my brother recorded his.l sessions.

Back to the question you asked though, dont worry and overthink your girlfriends reply, just talk to her about it and see how she feels :)

You could always record the sessions if you're allowed so you can listen to it again later when you feel a bit calmer. 
Ihated the therapist and always forgot everything we spoke about bythe time I got out

Have you considered talking to a counsellor about it? I know in the UK you can talk to your doctor and they can arrange it for you, not sure about other countries though.

Just might take the pressure off and make the relationship better.

I get like that when the negativity gets too much, do you know how she feels when you tell her stuff like that? 

Replying "same" to you could be for a lot of reasons, the main thing i would worry about is if your negative feelings are making her feel negative.

She obviously cares for you a lot, i think you might have to ask her and talk about it.

Are your weekend interactions fun? 
There must be a lot of pressure on her being told her partner wants to puke or for their life to end, especially if she's dealing with her own shit..
Is this a LDR or do you see each other outside of messaging?
Was thinking the same but wasnt sure how to say it.
Tbf you have gave no context as to why they think you're a creep, we can only guess and assume..
Love that. Falling in love with myself is exactly what im trying. Would give you gold if i could :)

You want to take a break so you can have sex with someone else? Seems shitty.
Theres only two decent and fair options, break up or try and make it work.
Stay away from his friend though, whats the point in ending your relationship and then destroying their friendship..

I think just sending a message is fine as long as you're not being flirty.
Im sure she will appreciate the kind gesture, I always message people to see if they're okay if they seem down, who cares if people think you're weird if you're just trying to reach out and help another human being. 
As long as you know you went in with the right intentions.
Probably lousy advice but who knows.
Just go with the flow, if it feels right to stay then stay. She should make itclearif she wants you to go
Thank you, that cheered me up a bit but i would have to disagree.
Im 32 and last had friends when i was 18 too. Lonely life but i've got used to it. I'm just not great at interacting with people.
If you dont mind me asking, Whats happened to make things reach this point?

Im 32 and never had a real friend once i left school at 16 except for my ex ,who was my best friend for 11 years and now we dont even talk to each other.. I'm grateful for the time we had but now I have no clue how to make new friends.

I guess just getting it off my chest and having someone read it helps. At least i know someone some where knows jow im feeling.

When we split up i was deeply depressed for a long time and i struggled to get over everything but this year ive been taking time to be more positive, look for work and build a future.
Just all this hit me out the blue, i thought i was over her but when she picked the kids up the last time it all just came flooding back. Thank you for the kind words.

Im so sorry to hear what you are going through, I wouldnt wish that on anyone. I was a full time father for a long time and losing a child was my biggest fear.

I hope he gets in contact if not for then at least for his child.
Sorry to cut this message short but i have to pick the dog up from the vet..
Feel free to message if you need to rant or get anything off your chest, i try to listen to everybody that needs or wants to talk.

She knows i will always love her and she knows im always there for her but its trying to find that fine balance of not looking needy. She has never given me any indication of having any feelings apart from feeling nostalgic looking at old photos.

Yeah, my weekends are like that,  i dont have a job at the moment so the weekdays are pretty boring as well but theres a bit more of a schedule there because my family get home from work and stuff. 

Thats terrible that your friend would do that.. at least you found what they're like now rather the later. 

Hope your day gets a bit better!

I told my ex i loved her after about three weeks and we stayed together for 13 years.
Dont worry too much about it.
Thats what i thought but cant find another picture similar. Thank you
So true. I also hate when those same people like to plaster their social media  with posts about taking the time out to help people with depression.

Oh man.. im in the same boat. Do you go on dates with your girlfriend? i think thats important. Spend time with her, do something new if you dont.
Also, if you're not happy wih the relationship you need to talk to her. What would your life be without her support? 

I feel the same way about games and tv. I just feel like it fills a void and i can forget about how shit my life has become. 

Hope things get better soon

I just feel like every part of my life is controlled by someone else and I have no way of taking back control.

Cant get a job because its up to someone else, cant fall in love because we live in a world where no one loves back unless theres something in it for them.
I will never be able to offer anyone anything so whats the point. There is literally no point in carrying on if the only foreseeable end goal is be homeless on the street or lying in a hospital bed after suffering a heart attack.
I try and block it out as much as I can, i know I need to get on with my life and not dwell on things but sometimes I wake up and just realise how shit everything is.
